body.name: Exact verifier \(\mathsf{Verify}\)
body.construction: Replay \(\tau\) using the fixed branch order; recompute every legality bit by exhaustive intervention and boundary assignment; check every algebraic coordinate by Sturm isolation and every simplex sign exactly; recompute the product-source probabilities without merging source blocks; verify \(\Phi(\theta^-)=\Phi(\theta^+)=p^*\), every row in \(I_{\partial}\), \(K(\theta^-)K(\theta^+)>0\), and the exact sign of \(\Delta_q\); decode both models and recheck their alphabets, source incidence, equations, and subset unique solvability. Accept if and only if every check succeeds.
